cohort: The study included 96 infants and children with all maxillary and mandibular primary anterior teeth and at least two primary molars erupted clinically in the oral cavity, divided into ECC and non-ECC groups.
finding: The proportion of high caries risk subjects was significantly more in the non-ECC groups, and caries risk was found to increase with increasing age.
mod_finding: Children delivered by the C-section mode showed high caries risk (66.7%) when compared with the vaginal mode of delivery (53.3%).
cross-section timing: Infants and children were assessed when they had all maxillary and mandibular primary anterior teeth and at least two primary molars erupted clinically.
